Class ServerEventHandlerVisitor

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.net.control.ServerEventHandlerVisitor
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualView
public class ServerEventHandlerVisitor extends Object implements VirtualView
The ServerEventHandlerVisitor class serves as a visitor for handling various server events by processing and updating UI and view flow states accordingly
